name: The Alpha Underground - Part 1
source:
The Alpha Underground is a sci-fi erotic visual novel about a shady underground facility that experiments with muscle-growing their helpless test subjects.

Francis is a grumpy old bear who gets a chance at settling up on his massive debts when he is referred to The Alpha Underground. All he has to do is sign away his rights and become a guinea pig for some weird experiments held by a perverted yet genius scientist. Francis gets paid per pound of muscle he gains while undergoing this trial so if he wants to make a ton of cash, he'll have to put on a ton of muscle. 

How will Francis fare surrounded by other test subjects, mysteriously masked and jacked servants, and all the weights he can lift?

[From [url=https://wolfyama.itch.io/the-alpha-underground]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《阿尔法地下》是一部科幻色情视觉小说，讲述了一个阴暗的地下设施，对无助的测试对象进行肌肉生长实验。

弗朗西斯是一只脾气暴躁的老熊，当他被提到阿尔法地下组织时，他有机会偿还巨额债务。他所要做的就是放弃自己的权利，成为一名变态天才科学家进行的一些奇怪实验的小白鼠。弗朗西斯在接受这次试验时每增加一磅肌肉就能获得报酬，所以如果他想赚一大笔钱，他就必须增加大量肌肉。

弗朗西斯将如何面对其他测试对象、神秘的蒙面和穿着夹克的仆人以及他能举起的所有重量？

[来自[url=https://wolfyama.itch.io/the-alpha-underground]Itch.io[/url]]
